title: Bifibrant comparison for enriched localization inside a chunk
statement:
Use combinatorial simplicial model categories, their cofibrant and fibrant objects, and weak equivalences as in [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus], and enriched localization and Dwyer--Kan equivalences as in [lem-coef-simplicial-localization-comparison-calculus]. Fix sufficiently large universes. Let $\mathcal A$ be a combinatorial simplicial model category and $U\subseteq\mathcal A$ a small full simplicial subcategory satisfying the following chunk closure conditions, with choices functorial by simplicially enriched functors. For every finite fan $X\to Y_i$ in $U$, the product map factors as a trivial cofibration $X\to Z$ followed by a fibration $Z\to\prod_iY_i$ with $Z\in U$; for every finite cofan $Y_i\to X$ in $U$, the coproduct map factors as a cofibration $\coprod_iY_i\to Z$ followed by a trivial fibration $Z\to X$ with $Z\in U$. Empty families are included. Write $U^f=U\cap\mathcal A^f$, $U^{cf}=U\cap\mathcal A^{cf}$, and let $W$ be the model weak equivalences between objects of $U^f$. Inclusion followed by enriched localization induces a Dwyer--Kan equivalence
$$\eta_U:U^{cf}\longrightarrow U^f[W^{-1}].$$
This is the comparison using the actual enriched mapping simplicial sets. For a simplicial functor $F:U\to U'$ between such chunks in possibly different combinatorial simplicial model categories, if $F$ carries fibrant objects, bifibrant objects and weak equivalences to objects and arrows of the corresponding kind, the square of $\eta_U,\eta_{U'}$ with the restrictions of $F$ and its induced localization map commutes.
